title: vicia sativa var. angustifolia
intro: Vicia sativa var. angustifolia, commonly known as narrow-leaved vetch, is a type of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It is native to Europe and Western Asia, but has been naturalized in other parts of the world. Narrow-leaved vetch is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as arthritis and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its sedative and anti-spasmodic effects.
